scope: One complete cold workspace apply across all workers. Setup, transactions, matching, and cleanup count. Diagnostic EXPLAIN does not count.
nativeSourceTreeDigestFormat: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON of sorted [repository path, file SHA-256] pairs for every native/src/**/*.rs file.
performanceInterpretation: Single cold samples under shared machine load. CPU and RSS regress. Execution-budget acceptance is not a speedup claim. Buffered profiling and EXPLAIN timings are not unprofiled runtime.
